items.title: Alan Raph interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: We did, he did “The Wiz,” the movie “The Wiz,” which was huge sessions of many, many musicians. In fact on one session I played tuba along with Dave Bargeron, Don Butterfield and Tony Price.

ctx.x: I wanted to mention a couple of people here that you’ve worked with. Quincy Jones?
I love Quincy. I love Quincy. He kissed me. Did I tell you that?
